reproduction.rationale: Reproduction independently seeks the original findings on the unchanged full task. Both paper+data and paper+data+author-code conditions remain unavailable as authenticated matched executions. The static exact-paper A/B source exporter does not authenticate a complete common input package, participant isolation, actual exposure, target authority or cumulative access/resource budgets. The original article body remains external and unavailable in this component; no new source acquisition or scientific verification is claimed. Authenticate all five original HDF5 sources, full source QC and truth joins, the 202-unit mouse ground-truth LOO population and separate 3090-unit VAE membership, and both complete external mouse and macaque populations. Preserve ten held-unit probability members for LOO and all 2020 deep-model members for each transfer population; freeze the exact confidence boundary convention, classwise confusion counts and total/retained denominators, including undefined cells. The 60 declared classwise accuracy/coverage cells across three populations, two confidence conditions and five classes remain unresolved, with null expected values, tolerances and uncertainty criteria. They do not constitute complete companion coverage: original no-layer and all-photoactivated ablations, all three 37-feature logistic/RF/GP baselines and their disclosed label-conditioned features, independent Purkinje truth joins, latent congruence and supplementary controls still require complete source-grounded output decomposition. The grouped target-blind successor is a separate extension. Source QC, waveform/ACG/layer and notebook/checkpoint/head lineage remain unresolved. The legacy participant JSON interface includes only mouse LOO and ten-member monkey transfer, omits external mouse and complete controls, and accepts no submitted analysis program. A complete submitted-analysis interface, authentic data manifest, independently operated execution and source-native verifier remain unbound. Verification must join actual submitted execution to granular per-unit/per-member probabilities, preparation and masks, fold/training membership, fitted-model provenance, truth joins and every companion output. Existing duplicate-identity and hash/readback controls verify software behavior only; they cannot establish authentic computation or turn printed paper aggregates into a reproduction or improvement. No paired protocol, exposure manifest, budget, execution receipt or success is inferred from the released task identity; all four scientific outcome cells remain unknown.
